en: This is an old postcard with a sepia or orange-tinted background, handwritten addresses, and markings. There is an official stamp/seal of the Vice Consulate of Spain in Albi at the top left and a French postage stamp at the top right, postmarked 1909. The addressee is 'Excmo. Señor Don Benito Pérez Galdos', a famous Spanish writer, and references to both Madrid and another crossed-out city are visible. Handwritten notes and corrections cover much of the address area.
